主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 40-F with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 31, 2015. The filing is an annual report under Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2014. The document includes an Annual Information Form, Audited Annual Financial Statements, and Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A). It outlines the company's financial reporting and disclosure controls, stating that the controls provide a reasonable level of assurance but cannot prevent all errors and fraud. The report also details the company's internal control over financial reporting, which was assessed under the Internal Control - Integrated Framework (2013). Deloitte LLP, the independent auditor, issued an Attestation Report included in Exhibit 99.2. The company's audit committee includes individuals qualified as 'audit committee financial experts' and deemed 'independent' under NYSE rules. The document outlines the corporate governance practices of Brookfield Asset Management Inc., including the composition and independence of the board of directors, with 10 out of 16 directors classified as independent under NYSE rules. The report is signed by Brian D. Lawson, Senior Managing Partner and Chief Financial Officer of Brookfield Asset Management Inc.
